headline: A 2012 executive order tells federal agencies to find and reduce burdens created by existing regulations.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, directs federal agencies to look at rules already on the books and find ones that create unneeded burdens. Agencies are expected to work on reducing those burdens. The official title is the only source provided, so the exact steps and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to review their existing rules and work to reduce the burdens those rules create.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and individuals who must follow federal rules
who_it_affects.how: They may see some existing rules changed or removed if agencies find them unnecessarily burdensome.
